## Microprocessor-Based Systems Labs {#e155}

[Microprocessor-Based Systems: Design and Applications (ENGR155) |
Fall 2026]{.entry-meta}

FPGA and microcontroller labs on a Lattice iCE40UP5K FPGA and an
STM32L432KC microcontroller, each documented in a full lab report. See the
[lab reports](labs.qmd).

## Multicycle RISC-V Processor {#riscv}

[Digital Electronics and Computer Engineering (ENGR85) |
Spring 2026]{.entry-meta}

Designed a multicycle RISC-V processor in SystemVerilog that supports about
30 instructions. I built it bottom-up: the individual modules first, then the
control path and its finite state machine, then the datapath. Each module has
its own unit testbench, and the complete processor was verified in QuestaSim
by running a system-level assembly program and checking register values in
the waveforms.

**Skills:** SystemVerilog, RISC-V, finite state machines, QuestaSim

## FPGA State Machine and Keyboard Labs {#e85-labs}

[Digital Electronics and Computer Engineering (ENGR85) |
Spring 2026]{.entry-meta}

Built an LED-driving finite state machine and a four-key digital music
keyboard that plays notes through an amplified speaker, both in SystemVerilog
on an Altera Cyclone V E FPGA.

**Skills:** SystemVerilog, Quartus Prime, Altera Cyclone V E

## Submersible ROV {#rov}

[Introduction to Engineering Systems (ENGR79) | Fall 2025]{.entry-meta}

Capstone project for a course on linear time-invariant systems, completed on
a two-person team. We assembled a remotely operated vehicle with a PVC frame
and instrumented it with a thermistor for temperature and a pressure sensor
for depth, using a custom PCB provided by the course. I designed and analyzed
the RLC sensor-interface circuits and calibrated both sensors. For depth
control, I chose the proportional gain from a Laplace-domain model of the
vehicle built from its measured mass, buoyancy, and drag, then checked it
against a LabVIEW simulation and step responses in a test tank. Data was
collected with a National Instruments myDAQ.

**Skills:** RLC circuit design and analysis, sensor calibration, proportional
control, Laplace-domain modeling, LabVIEW, myDAQ
